svg.title: SyncLayer brand sheet
svg.desc: SyncLayer brand sheet, light theme. Shows the four-block symbol with its clear space, the horizontal lockup, the symbol at 16, 24 and 32 px in one ink, the color palette (bg #F6F8FA, surface #FFFFFF, surface-2 #EAEFF3, text #0B1118, text-2 #44525F, text-3 #5B6874, accent #0B7A6B, border #D0D9E1, ok #1A7F37, warn #8A5A00, error #C0362C, info #1F5FBF), a type specimen in IBM Plex Sans 600, 400 and 500 and IBM Plex Mono 500 and 400 at 32, 24, 20, 16 and 14 px, and the usage rules. Clear space: Keep 1 u free on every side of the symbol. Minimum size: 16 px. Use symbol-16 between 16 and 24 px. Monochrome: A one-ink version is required. The gaps hold the shape. Flat: No gradients, shadows or outlines. Pattern: Never repeat the symbol as a pattern. Imagery: Do not pair it with brains, robots, circuits or sparkles. Accent: Under 5 % of a composition; the symbol is the exception.
